segment.description: South Fork Holston River below Boone Dam (Boone tailwater), Sullivan County
segment.boundaries: Short flashy reach from Boone Dam to the Fort Patrick Henry Reservoir head; TWRA regs for the reach are set under the Fort Patrick Henry rule (Boone Dam downstream to Louis Milhorn Bridge)

coldSource.notes: No reachable TVA document states Boone Dam's withdrawal structure type; TVA's Boone Reservoir health page shows poor forebay/mid-reservoir dissolved oxygen ratings (https://tva.com/environment/environmental-stewardship/water-quality/reservoir-health-ratings/boone-reservoir), consistent with strong stratification, but that is not direct evidence of release temperature. Documented stocking program for this reach (owner-supplied 2026-09-17 TWRA workbook): Mar, Apr, Nov, Dec rainbow+brown - the fishery is actively maintained in the cold months; whether trout also persist through summer (via survival, or unrecorded stocking) is the open question.

holdover.detail: No agency or multiple-independent-angler documentation of summer holdover found in this pass.

wildPopulation.detail: No evidence of natural reproduction found in this pass; unknown.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: The documented stocking program runs Mar, Apr, Nov, Dec - the fishery is maintained in cold months, and whether trout persist through the unstocked summer months (survival or unrecorded stocking) is unresolved because no temperature data or documented release type was found; the catalog's yearRound:true flag remains the owner's call.
